WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, p.product_name, f.net_amount, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1),
a AS (
  SELECT w.sku, any_value(w.product_name) AS product_name,
         sum(w.net_amount) - coalesce(sum(r.refund_net), 0) AS net_sales_after_returns,
         sum(CASE WHEN w.sale_date <= DATE '2026-09-27' THEN w.net_amount - coalesce(r.refund_net,0) ELSE 0 END) AS alt_to_p05
  FROM w LEFT JOIN r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY w.sku
)
SELECT sku, product_name, net_sales_after_returns, rank() OVER (ORDER BY alt_to_p05 DESC) AS alt_rank_to_p05, (SELECT count(DISTINCT product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku = a.sku) AS n_names
FROM a ORDER BY net_sales_after_returns DESC LIMIT 12
